title: Place Value Worksheets: 3-Digit Expanded Form
intro: Use expanded form to show the value represented by each digit.
html:
Teaching notes for parents and teachers

How to teach it

Build the number with hundreds, tens, and ones, then record the matching sum. Discuss a zero place explicitly.

Example to work through together

Use the model below as you explain the example. Have your student point to the quantities as you discuss them.

352 = 300 + 50 + 2

Three hundreds + five tens + two ones make the same 352.

Ask your student

What amount does this digit contribute to the number?

If your student needs help

If the student writes just the digit names, connect each digit to its group of units.
